issues.observation: The default captures show the complete expanded third attempt; supplementary top captures show ordered headers 1–3 and collapsed thumbnails. They jointly satisfy the state. Normal timeline scrolling is not occlusion.
issues.repair_suggestion: No UI repair required. Keep both scroll positions together in the acceptance evidence.

issues.observation: Library captures show the retained lighthouse item and complete preview; verify-after-delete captures show only the remaining session. Library seed metadata is explicitly permitted. In the narrow library view, the lower item continues beyond the vertical viewport.
issues.repair_suggestion: No UI repair required. Keep image-page and library captures paired; do not treat library seed metadata or normal vertical scrolling as defects.
